intent: A round highland of old snow whose middle is one great frozen lake, crossed by the hill road between two shores, with a runestone ring at the ice and barrows spaced on the outer high ground.
requests: A walkable ice or water cell kind, so a frozen lake can be its own ground instead of heath hidden under a sheet of ice landmarks (mist and props then need no keep-out over it).
A way for landmarks(map, rng) to read the geometry the map was generated with, so the shore of a generated lake can be found without carrying it as an extra field on the map.
